fields.name: emergencyNumber
fields.label: Local emergency number
fields.description: The number to call for an ambulance where the frame is: 112 in Europe, 911 in North America, 000 in Australia. Leave it empty to hide it.

fields.name: allergies
fields.label: Allergies
fields.description: One per line. Shown first, in large type.

fields.name: contacts
fields.label: Emergency contacts
fields.description: One per line: Name, relation, phone. For example: Sam Example, partner, +32 470 12 34 56

fields.name: medications
fields.label: Medications
fields.description: One per line, with the dose.

fields.name: organDonor
fields.label: Organ donor
fields.description: For example: Yes, or: Yes, card in wallet

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Anything else a helper should know: a spare key, a pet, a language.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

jsxUi.name: Emergency card
jsxUi.description: An in case of emergency card from the scene's settings: allergies first and loudest, the contacts to call with QR codes that dial them, conditions, medications and more, the type as large as the panel lets it be.
